scope: Standing Tokyo Stock Exchange at 2-1 Nihonbashi Kabutocho, including the granite market building, its recessed public entry, and the 15-storey office building behind.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Architect documents market and office building sequence, completed 1988 complex, and split-face granite consciously used for shadowed monumental features.
Architect gives 15 above-ground floors, two penthouse levels and maximum height 78.8 m. The seismic upgrade was completed below the main roof wall.
Current exchange addresses and public access positions correspond to the named Kabutocho complex.
